state.claim: UNIVERSAL SERRE WEIGHT PARITY OBSTRUCTION FOR THREE ODD EXPONENTS: For any hypothetical solution to A^p + B^q = C^r with p, q, r odd primes >= 3, the Serre weights of the associated residual representations are mutually incompatible at 2.
state.method: Serre modularity conjectures, Fontaine-Laffaille weights, 2-adic wild ramification, Artin representations
state.target: Beal's Conjecture: If A^x + B^y = C^z with A, B, C, x, y, z positive integers and x, y, z >= 3, then gcd(gcd(A, B), C) > 1. Equivalently, no coprime positive integer solutions exist for min(x,y,z) >= 3. Dead categories: single-signature Kraus sieves, bounded exponent searches, Baker linear forms, elementary congruences. Live directions: a unifying modular/motivic object for three independent exponents, and effective Diophantine geometry.

legend.3: level 3: constructs a universal modular or motivic obstruction that applies simultaneously to all triples (x, y, z) >= 3
